Here are some (limited) instances where my work has been featured in various media!

# Astrobites Article

Astrobites is an awesome website where graduate and upper-level undergaduate Astronomy students take papers they find interesting and synthesize the main context and results into a more easily digestible article.
You can find an astrobite article of my first published paper [here](https://astrobites.org/2025/07/16/brahma-sims-mbh-sigma/)!

# CosmicAI Lightning Talk

As a member of the [CosmicAI](https://cosmicai.org/) institute, I gave a "lightning" talk about my project to develop "1000 Galaxies on FIRE".
Take a look [here](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/nsfsimonscosmicai_cosmicai-student-lightning-talk-with-jonathan-activity-7460345840650555393-l0bk)!
